info.name: Wholesale ERP & CRM Operations API
info.description: Complete Postman API Collection covering all REST API endpoints for the Wholesale ERP & CRM Operations Portal including Authentication, Customer Management (CRM), Products & Stock Audit Movements, Sales Delivery Challans, and Dashboard Analytics.
